text: Armaz Akhvlediani - The government supported Bishop Shio, this is clear, he was and is involved - we saw this and I suspect we will see it even before the start of the historic synod, where the patriarch is to be elected (28.04.2026, 19:37)

Perhaps for the final session, where the Synod is to elect the Patriarch, the configuration may change somewhat - Bishop Shio was promoted, but I would not rush and make a final conclusion, - politician Armaz Akhvlediani stated this in the "Resume" program of "Palitranius".
According to Armaz Akhvlediani, everything will depend on where the votes of the other two candidates go.

"The main decision is in the past, today only the candidates were selected by the Synod session, we already know the data, who received how many votes. Let's not forget that perhaps, for the final session, where the Synod is to select the Patriarch, it will not be ruled out that the configuration will change to some extent. However, today it is clear who was promoted, Bishop Shio was promoted, but I would not rush and make a final conclusion, unlike others.

"Today, the patriarch was not elected, today only three candidates were named, and while one is elected, the other two may agree on where their votes and those of others will go," said Armaz Akhvlediani.
According to Armaz Akhvlediani, it is clear that the government is interfering in the patriarchal elections and supporting Bishop Shio.

"The government supported Bishop Shio, this is clear. He was and is involved. Let's be honest, all the state media, from morning to evening, actively, in all contexts, no matter what topic they were talking about, directly or indirectly supported this one candidate. If this is not interference, then what is interference?! As for interference in other ways, I cannot talk about it, I do not have any facts that would say that I have. But, I have a well-founded suspicion and assumption that a bad government always has the leverage of influence, influence, and pressure, especially a government that has destroyed its authority and needs to seize something, in this case the authority of the Church acquired through inertia and use it as a basis. We have seen this throughout this time and I suspect that we will see this even before the start of the historic synod, where the final patriarch will be chosen," - said Armaz Akhvlediani.

For information, the Holy Synod has selected three candidates for the patriarchate. According to the Synod's decision, the candidates for the patriarchate will be: Metropolitan Shio (Mujiri) of Senaki and Chkhorotsku, Metropolitan Job of the Diocese of Urbnisi and Ruisi, and Metropolitan Grigoli of Poti and Khobi.

As the senior dean of the Patriarchate's Public Relations Department, Andria Jagmaidze, told journalists, the candidate for the patriarchal throne, Shio, received 20 votes, while the other two candidates received 7 votes each. According to his explanation, the other candidates were Bishop Grigol Katsia, Bishop Dositheos, and Bishop Melchizedek.
